title: The Drifting Engine
summary: Every drifting carriage now has a Drifting Engine Block built into it. It burns one coal each time the carriage drifts into a new world, and a carriage that runs out of fuel stops drifting for good. Feed it coal or charcoal to keep a carriage you love on the line.
highlights: Coal you add counts straight away, and you can take it back out before you leave the world
The gauge shows how many more worlds the carriage can reach
Anyone can mine an engine, but it takes as long as obsidian
description: It burns to keep your carriages alive. Taking them beyond your world, into the world of others. Let it extinguish, the train forgets it. Move it to a new carriage, and move which carriage drifts with the train.
